LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_WhatItDoes: In the game as it comes, a mech recharger draws the same power whichever mech stands on it, so the largest war machine costs no more to charge than a mid-sized one. With the setting below on, a recharger draws by the size of the mech on it: little for a small one, a great deal for a large one. Off by default.
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_SettingRealPower: Mech rechargers draw power by the size of the mech
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_SettingRealPowerDes:
Off (the default): rechargers work as the game made them.

On: while it charges, a recharger draws {PERSIZE} W for each point of the mech's body size, at the battery size chosen below. A {LIGHTMECH} draws {LIGHT} W, a {SMALLMECH} {SMALL} W, a {HEAVYMECH} {HEAVY} W and a {HUGEMECH} {HUGE} W. This holds on every recharger, whatever power it lists.

Charging slows once the battery passes {EASES}, and the draw falls with it, so topping up to {EASES} is quick and the rest is slow. A mech group's recharge range decides where its mechs stop.

{HEAT} of the power becomes heat in the recharger's room. A recharger with no mech on it draws {IDLE} of its listed power.

A large mech can ask more than a small grid has. Then the game switches things off at random, as it does in any power shortage.

Takes effect at once; no restart needed.
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_SettingBatteryScale: How much a mech's battery holds, and so how much power its recharger draws. Charging takes the same time at every size. Only matters while the setting above is on.
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_ScaleStandard: Standard: a {LIGHTMECH} draws {LIGHT} W, a {HEAVYMECH} {HEAVY} W
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_ScaleLarge: Large, {TIMES} times standard: a {LIGHTMECH} draws {LIGHT} W, a {HEAVYMECH} {HEAVY} W
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_ScaleHuge: Huge, {TIMES} times standard: a {LIGHTMECH} draws {LIGHT} W, a {HEAVYMECH} {HEAVY} W
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_ChargingEasingLine: Charging {MECH}: {WATTS} W, slowing as the battery fills. About {TIME} to go.
LanguageData.PhobosBiotechPatches_WaitingForPower: Waiting for power: {MECH} needs {WATTS} W to charge.
